indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX email_outbox_created_idx ON public.email_outbox USING btree (created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX email_outbox_pkey ON public.email_outbox USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX email_outbox_retry_idx ON public.email_outbox USING btree (status, retry_after) WHERE ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying])::text[]))

percentileMethod: Nearest rank, ceil(n*p)-1, milliseconds; client performance.now() wall time.
